evaluation: 2025-01-15 through 2025-01-21 UTC; all 41 complete price zones, original corrected ENTSO-E prices
solar: ERA5 hourly radiation at t represents preceding hour. Move PV source coefficient t+1 to model hour-start t. Keep wind, destination-hour commissioning and all original arrays. No circular roll or endpoint filling.
capacity: Apply German reported 2025 annual net capacity by source calendar year to coal/lignite/gas upper bounds, proportional to existing source-country MW and common tranche shares. No observed-generation cap or outage assumption. Annual snapshot and scope limitations remain explicit.
freeze: Existing bids, hydro, demand, network matrix, GSK, links and rating/flow offsets unchanged. No fit or selection. All outcomes reported; emergency use disqualifies a case as a valid supply model.
forecasts: SMARD forecast archives for diagnostics only; as-of-auction vintages unverified. No realized generation substituted for available renewable supply.
annual: No annual accuracy or investment acceptance claim; year-boundary ERA5 endpoint required before an annual corrected profile can be certified.
